rules: not operationalisable: Pure position-sizing / account-capital advice (open at $500-1,000, step size in micro-contract increments, halve size when panicking). Per-trade R outcomes on XAUUSD OHLC are invariant to contract count, so no test of R can distinguish scaling schedules; the only stated triggers ('earned', 'panic', 'comfortable level') are subjective and the measurables (rule-break rate, self-reported anxiety) need a trader's journal, not price data.
